articles.title: Ember Storm — Dance (Spectral)
articles.summary: Almost pure black, glossy, with sparse tiny ember sparks scattered like faint stars; spectral flame structure barely visible. A black gloss car with a faint orange-red spark dusting; at distance the sparks become a barely visible warm freckle and the body reads as plain black.
articles.what: Procedural flame finish: ember storm structure with the dance spec mode (spectral palette). FRACTURED FLAMES. Up close: Pure black ground with sparse short vertical ember streaks, 8-25 px tall and 1-2 px wide, bright orange-yellow at the bottom tip and fading to red up the tail, like sparks rising. A few are white. About 1% of the area is lit; the rest is plain black. The preview title shows a lost dash as ???. From a distance: A black gloss car with a faint orange-red spark dusting; at distance the sparks become a barely visible warm freckle and the body reads as plain black. Measured spec (average): metal 214, roughness 28, coat 234. Shine: gloss. Metal: high. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, roof, hero panel.
Fits: gt / sports car, open wheel, show car.
how: This finish is not listed in the Base Material picker, so you cannot pick it there.
Open the AI copilot (the ✦ AI button, bottom right) and ask for it by name, for example "put Ember Storm — Dance (Spectral) on the hood".
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Lower body and rockers: sparks look like they rise from the ground
Hood and roof: sparse sparks read on wide black panels
White, yellow or orange numbers read very well; the sparks are too sparse to matter.
Flames in orange or red: match the embers and add the fire above them
Pairs well with: chrome, silver, deep red, matte black.
Not listed in the picker: ask the AI copilot for it by name.
pitfalls: Not a flame finish: only spark streaks, no flame shapes
Not a starry sky: the specks are short vertical streaks, not round dots
Avoid: large dark areas in the sim swallow the sparks, next to brighter flame finishes.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 214 (true metallic), roughness 28 (wet mirror gloss), clearcoat 234 (almost no clearcoat).
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: large dark areas in the sim swallow the sparks, next to brighter flame finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: flames in orange or red: match the embers and add the fire above them; chrome or white stripes and lettering: pop hard on the mirror black
Patterns to avoid: glitter or speckle patterns: bury the sparse sparks; dark patterns that vanish
Spec overlays that work: matte stripe: contrast band against the mirror; skip flake: would swamp the sparks
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
